For two semesters, Fall 2017 and Fall 2018, I taught an accelerated honors single variable
calculus course at JHU. The course covers two semesters worth of calculus --- differentiation and
integration --- in one, structured as a flipped classroom.

The course is designed in an IBL format. The prerequisites are pre-calculus and basic theorem
proving.
